khamyang_roman: maa1 am1 kat4 yaa3 waat4 haang1
lik_tai: မႃဢမ်ႇၵတ်းယႃႇဝၢတ်ႈႁၢင်
assamese_script: মা¹ আম¹ কাত⁴ য়া³ ৱাত⁴ হাং¹
translation_en: If a dog cannot bite, it should not wag its tail aggressively.
translation_as: যি কুকুৰে কামুৰিব নোৱাৰে, সি যেন নেজ জোকাৰি ভাবুকি নিদিয়ে।
meaning_en: Do not make empty boasts or threats if you lack the competence or resolve to back them up (deeds over empty words).
cultural_context: Common village proverb admonishing young men against braggadocio during village assemblies (chaw1 baan3).

khamyang_roman: nam6 sung1 paa1 kin1 mot4, nam6 bok4 mot4 kin1 paa1
lik_tai: ၼမ်ႉသုင်ပႃၵိၼ်မူတ်ႉ၊ ၼမ်ႉဝူၵ်းမူတ်ႉၵိၼ်ပႃ
assamese_script: নাম⁶ সুং¹ পা¹ কিন¹ মত⁴, নাম⁶ বক্⁴ মত⁴ কিন¹ পা¹
translation_en: When the river is high, fish eat ants; when the water recedes dry, ants eat fish.
translation_as: নৈৰ পানী বাঢ়িলে মাছে পৰুৱা খায়; পানী শুকাই গ'লে পৰুৱাই মাছ খায়।
meaning_en: Fortune is ever-changing; one must treat others with kindness in times of prosperity because positions may soon reverse.
cultural_context: Pan-Tai classical proverb deeply ingrained in the riverine ecology of the Dihing river basin.

khamyang_roman: kin1 phak1 heu3 haan5 phlu1, kin1 khaw3 heu3 haan5 naa1
lik_tai: ၵိၼ်ၽၵ်းႁႂ်ႈႁၢၼ်ႈၽလူ၊ ၵိၼ်ၶဝ်ႈႁႂ်ႈႁၢၼ်ႈၼႃး
assamese_script: কিন¹ ফাক¹ হেউ³ হান⁵ ফ্লু¹, কিন¹ খাও³ হেউ³ হান⁵ না¹
translation_en: When eating greens, remember the climbing vine; when eating rice, remember the flooded paddy field.
translation_as: শাক খাওঁতে লতাডালক স্মৰণ কৰা, ভাত খাওঁতে পথাৰখনক স্মৰণ কৰা।
meaning_en: Always remain grateful to your benefactors and remember the labor and origins that made your sustenance possible.
cultural_context: Traditional moral teaching recited to children at the dining table on stilted verandas.

khamyang_roman: nok4 mi5 pik4 bin1 dai3, khon1 mi5 panyaa1 pai1 dai3
lik_tai: ၼူၵ်ႉမီႈပိၵ်ႉမိၼ်လႆႈ၊ ၶူၼ်မီႈပၺ်ၺႃပႆလႆႈ
assamese_script: নুক⁴ মী⁵ পিক⁴ বিন¹ দাই³, খুন¹ মী⁵ পন্যা¹ পাই¹ দাই³
translation_en: A bird with wings can fly across the skies; a person endowed with wisdom can journey anywhere in the world.
translation_as: ডেউকা থকা চৰায়ে আকাশত উৰিব পাৰে; জ্ঞান থকা মানুহে সমগ্ৰ পৃথিৱী ভ্ৰমণ কৰিব পাৰে।
meaning_en: Knowledge, literacy (lik), and wisdom provide the true means of freedom and advancement.
cultural_context: Chanted at the monastic school (bapuchang) encouraging young novices to master Lik Tai manuscripts.

khamyang_roman: mai6 laam1 phaa3 phak1 yaa3 luang3, khon1 laam1 waam1 sop4 yaa3 sia1
assamese_script: মাই⁶ লাম¹ ফা³ ফাক¹ য়া³ লুৱাং³, খুন¹ লাম¹ ৱাম¹ সপ⁴ য়া³ সিয়া¹
translation_en: When splitting bamboo do not ruin the weaving strip; when speaking words do not utter that which ruins your name.
translation_as: বাঁহ ফলাৰ সময়ত বেত নষ্ট নকৰিবা; কথা কোৱাৰ সময়ত মুখৰ বাক্যৰে নিজৰ মান হেৰুৱাই নেপেলাবা।
meaning_en: Measure your words with care; a spoken word, like cut bamboo, cannot be taken back.
cultural_context: Craft allegory connecting daily bamboo basketry with verbal restraint.

khamyang_roman: khrɔk4 tam1 khaw3 bo1 mi5 sak4, hɯn1 thaai1 bo1 mi5 po5
assamese_script: খ্ৰক্⁴ তাম¹ খাও³ বাে¹ মী⁵ সাক⁴, হ্যুন¹ থাই¹ বাে¹ মী⁵ পৌ⁵
translation_en: A rice mortar without a pestle is like a stilted household without a guiding father.
translation_as: থোৰা নোহোৱা ঢেঁকী আৰু পিতৃ নোহোৱা চাংঘৰ একেই আধৰুৱা।
meaning_en: Every functional household requires leadership, unity, and supportive stewardship.
cultural_context: Traditional family proverb emphasizing parental roles in the household economy.
